notes.title: Patch notes v 1.7, Jan 6 2022
notes.content: Korean subtitles should work again. Sorry about that!

notes.title: Update notes for May 17th, 2021 (tiny issue)
notes.content: There was a teeny little unintentional spike on the floor collider at orange hell, some people were getting stuck on it. Fixed.

notes.title: Update notes for May 16 2021 (very minor changes)
notes.content:
- Ctrl-R speedrunner reset key no longer works if it's the player's first run.
- You can't accidentally start a game while the settings menu is up.

notes.title: Version 1.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 1.6. This is mainly a big compatibility update to new version of Unity, should help the game to run on newer hardware (including Apple M1) and also produce smoother gameplay. Thanks to the Discord community for helping to test it and iron out bugs.

As always, the older versions are still there on Steam if you prefer them. Go to the properties for the game, go to the betas tab, type password 'nakedmaninapot' and choose the version you want (the previous version was 1.599).

Detailed changes:
- Build is signed for running on newer versions of MacOS
- Small change to the shape of the pot collider that should reduce the incidence of the pot unexpectedly gripping to the world, especially on slopes. I tested this with the speedrunning community, seems it shouldn’t have a major impact on feel, just make the game a tiny bit more consistent.
- Finally fixed the rare save game bug, I hope
- Finally fixed the perf issue with the particles near the antenna 
- Couple of extra little spots where the hammer could get stuck (barrel and toilet) fixed. It's never going to be perfect, though!
- Fix an issue where going from back to the settings menu would revert language to English
- Maybe a couple other things, I forget.
